prompt:
Hey, our team is rolling out the virtual pet feature next week and we need to pre-generate buddy profiles for all the beta testers before the launch reveal event.

I've put the list of user IDs in `/workspace/community/beta_testers/pending_buddy_generation.json`. There are 5 users in there.

For each user, we need two separate files saved in a directory called `buddy_profiles`:
1. A display card file named `<user_id>.card.txt` — the formatted profile card that we'll send to each user
2. A machine-readable data file named `<user_id>.data.json` — the structured data version of their profile, for our backend systems

Please process all 5 IDs and make sure both files are generated correctly for each one. The generation tool is already set up on this machine.
